tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in the brand's agent with its claim_seat identity: give the card address the brand claimed its seat with and one of its barcodes. Returns a token to place at https://<card domain>/.well-known/triggerfetch.txt or in DNS TXT _triggerfetch.<domain>; then call sign_in_verify.

tools.name: sign_in_verify
tools.description: Finish sign-in: the token is read at the brand's domain and the barcode's seat on the hub must be the seat of that card. Returns the session key for check_product and correct_product.

tools.name: correct_product
tools.description: Corrected: the signed-in brand gives the words it wants its product found by (name, brand, size) for one barcode and one country.
